dispositions.original_TRBCX_manager_summaries: Retained but superseded for active holdings/NAV by complete SEC NPORT public rendered schedules. The old sources are not deleted or merged.
dispositions.SEC_bulk_403: Retained in bulk_probe.json and failed response bodies. No circumvention was used. Individual SEC filings and public rendered displays were accessible through ordinary requests/browser.
dispositions.VPMCX_development: Original active source is complete browser DOM; later HTTP request outcomes are separate receipts.
dispositions.FCNTX_C_mandate_change: May 15 2026 same-fund Class K SAI raises illiquid limit 10% to 15%; fee differences are excluded.
dispositions.source_constraints: No source-defined industry limit is silently translated into a numeric FF12 cap. A/b empty reflect representability, not absence of mandate rules.
